note: Both sets capture the same core facts — grade level 0'-0", finished floor 2'-9 1/2", the revision block, project name and lot number — with correct quotes and no invented values. Set A additionally records the scale for SECTION - EAST MODULE (A1), which Set B omits entirely, while B only repeats the C1/West Module scale. Set A's two 'height above grade level' claims split the shared finished-floor datum across Section C1 and Section A1, which is duplicative rather than wrong, and both sets repeat the grade/finished-floor/scale facts several times under slightly different names. On balance A covers the page's engineering content more completely.
remarks: Both sets restate the same datum and scale facts 2-3 times under different entity/attribute spellings (e.g. 'Grade Level | elevation' vs 'GRADE LEVEL | elevation'; 'Section C1 | scale' vs 'Drawing C1 | scale'), inflating claim counts without adding information. The finished-floor datum is a single shared datum shown in both sections; Set A's per-section 'height above grade level' claims are true but duplicative. Neither set captured the sheet number A-301 or sheet title beyond the admin/neutral items, and the keynotes boxes appear empty on the page.
